pairs.why: A keeps the desert to a mesa, a few tufts and clean track, while B adds rocks, many shrubs, a mesa and an orange block, which makes the environment busier than the real cards' few large quiet shapes.
B is cropped tighter with water filling most of the card like the real close-up, but its caustic texture is busy; A is a wider scene with sky, clouds, sand and a hook, so the call is weak.
B's wall is a few quiet horizontal planks, while A's vertical panels add more small division lines behind the cap; both use a plank floor, so the difference is small.
A has quiet tone-on-tone vertical stripes like the real card, while B uses bold high-contrast diagonal stripes and a bright glow that compete with the anchor.
A has a quiet diamond backdrop and a plain ledge like the real popcorn card, while B adds a gridded tile floor with many lines that competes with the hero.
A has a smooth gradient backdrop and a curved ledge horizon like the real chair card, while B's angular slab with a hard edge reads as a more constructed stage.
A's pi pattern is tone-on-tone and soft with a glow behind the hero like the real card, while B's pi glyphs are denser and higher contrast and sit closer to the calculator.
Both put the helmet on a plain ledge in front of a flat colour field with no props, so staging gives no reason to choose.
